name: tiny6-paddleocr
description: No onnxruntime. PP-OCRv6 tiny with zero runtime dependencies using WASM SIMD kernels. Just a few KB!

scripts.check: bun tools/check.ts det --wasm && bun tools/check.ts rec --wasm
scripts.golden: bun tools/expose.ts models/det.onnx test/golden/det.exposed.onnx && bun tools/expose.ts models/rec.onnx test/golden/rec.exposed.onnx && bun tools/golden.ts
scripts.deploy:demo: bun run build && bun tools/stage-demo.ts && bunx wrangler deploy
